description: Defines classes, enums, and functions related to cookie change notifications and dispatching in the Chromium project, including CookieChangeDispatcher, CookieChangeInfo, and related callback mechanisms.

classes.name: CookieChangeSubscription
classes.description: Represents a subscription to cookie change events, manages listener interest lifecycle.

classes.name: CookieChangeDispatcher
classes.description: Abstract interface for observing and subscribing to cookie change events.

methods.name: AddCallbackForCookie
methods.description: Registers a callback for changes to specific cookies identified by URL and name.

methods.name: AddCallbackForUrl
methods.description: Registers a callback for changes to cookies associated with a specific URL.

methods.name: AddCallbackForAllChanges
methods.description: Registers a callback for all cookie store changes.
